title: Hydra: register a root agent in a hierarchical registry
summary: Initialise the Hydra registry, register a root agent, and see why a 33-byte name is rejected.
what: Hydra is an Anchor 0.32 program for a tree of agents: a registry holds root agents, which can later spawn children and share earnings. This lesson covers initialize and register_root_agent. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed on-chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/hydra/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/hydra/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize and register_root_agent campus-scout are already done.
try_steps.see: Program EKEHJMZi… . Fetch registry 7x3F2GgY… and agent 8E5gYQxr….

try_steps.do: A register_root_agent with a 33-byte name should fail.

instructions: spawn_child / earnings ixs exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A hierarchical on-chain agent tree with parent revenue share.
not_covered: spawn_child and earnings distribution were not exercised.
build: Anchor 0.32.1 program at EKEHJMZiGUex64aogXJdt7pRL66Ff46yLm2amUG6PWh8 on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Inspect the Hydra registry and a root agent, then explain why a 33-byte name is rejected.

learning_loop.objective: Read registry + root agent — then predict NameTooLong rejection.
learning_loop.predict_question: register_root_agent is called with a 33-byte name. What should happen?

predict_options.label: The name is truncated to 32 bytes and the agent is registered
The instruction fails with NameTooLong (or equivalent); no root agent is written
Any UTF-8 string length is accepted

learning_loop.predict_why: Hydra enforces a maximum root-agent name length in the program. Oversized names fail; the registry is not left with an illegal name.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/hydra/ on Devnet. Fetch the lab root agent (campus-scout) and config/registry evidence. Prefer observation of recorded initialize/register_root_agent proofs; explain NameTooLong from the exercise.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why should name-length limits be enforced on-chain rather than only in the form validator?
learning_loop.transfer: State the rejected name condition and one field you would re-read on a root agent account.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for Hydra elective: registry inspect + NameTooLong.

criteria.title: Inspects registry/root agent
criteria.question: Can the student locate registry and root-agent evidence?
criteria.support: Finds lab agent after a prompt.
criteria.independent: Records registry/agent addresses and name from evidence.
criteria.misconception: UI list alone proves registry state.

criteria.title: Explains NameTooLong
criteria.question: Can the student predict a 33-byte name rejection?
criteria.not_yet: Assumes any length works or silent truncate.
criteria.independent: States NameTooLong without writing illegal state.
criteria.misconception: Failed submit still created the agent.

criteria.title: Scopes to this slice
criteria.question: Does the student avoid claiming full hierarchy mastery from root register alone?
criteria.misconception: Root register proves all child-agent flows.

criteria.title: Evidence honesty
criteria.question: Are platform proofs labelled separately from live attempts?
